subject: Scaffold the Next.js + FastAPI app with subscription-first Claude
message:
Scaffold the Next.js + FastAPI app with subscription-first Claude

Next.js App Router frontend and FastAPI backend modeled on
requirements-management without its app-specific code. backend/run.sh
opens the SSH tunnel to the Phylax database on the Swivel RDS server.
Claude calls go through the Claude Agent SDK on the Claude subscription,
with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an auth-failure fallback only. A system/status
feature exercises every layer. Adds AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md guidance, scoped
Claude and Codex rules, /prime, and the shared agent skills.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

subject: Add scene survey with stored component coordinates and station-wall tour
message:
Add scene survey with stored component coordinates and station-wall tour

Detect with Grounding DINO on Modal and classify crops with the Decisions
API; rebuild the tour as a wall of fixed camera stations. Add a scene survey
that walks the whole scan, lifts every classified box into scene coordinates
through the committed voxel occupancy, and stores sightings and merged
objects in wapp.scene_observation and wapp.scene_object, with a line-of-sight
objects endpoint for rendering them from any view.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
